policy: shipped dict28.c four-probe FIFO chains (evict tail when chain length reaches PROBES=4)
delta_explanation: the Poisson terminal-size limit counts only buckets whose FINAL size is >=5; the shipped store also evicts during fill, so the measured loss exceeds 1-P(size>=5). The sign and size of the delta are what the transient predicts; both are reported, neither is charged.
lambda_integerisation: arrivals = round(lambda*4096) = 1153, so lambda_hat = 1153/4096 = 0.281494141 against exact 0.281541678 (relative error 1.69e-04); nb is a power of two, as dict28_ws_init requires
